units.source_text: 我从家里跑出去，打算去坐中央线火车。

en.t: I ran out of the house, intending to take a train on the Chuo Line.

units.source_text: 不幸的是我被警察抓住了，最后被送进医院。

en.t: Unfortunately, I was caught by the police and was eventually sent to the hospital.

units.source_text: 我突然被关进这个医院，心里还想着河童国。

en.t: After being suddenly shut up in this hospital, I still kept thinking of the land of the kappas.
How is Doctor Chakka doing now?

units.source_text: 哲学家马咯也许仍旧在七彩玻璃灯笼下看古书呢。

en.t: Perhaps the philosopher Mago is still reading old books beneath a seven-colored glass lantern.

units.source_text: 尤其是我的好朋友——那个烂了嘴巴的学生拉卟……

en.t: And above all, my good friend, the student Rappu with the rotting mouth...

units.source_text: 那是一个跟今天一样天气沉郁的下午，我正回忆过去，差点情不自禁叫出声来。

en.t: It was an afternoon as gloomy as today, and as I was recalling the past, I almost cried out despite myself.

units.source_text: 不知何是进来的，打鱼的河童巴咯站在我面前对我鞠躬示意呢。

en.t: Without my knowing when he had come in, the fisherman kappa Bago was standing before me and bowing to me.

units.source_text: 我冷静下来了以后——我不记得后来是哭了还是笑了，总之隔了这么长时间再次说河童话，我内心万分感动。

en.t: After I calmed down, I do not remember whether I later cried or laughed, but in any case, speaking kappa language again after so long moved me deeply.
